verdict.rationale: WorkOS documents webhooks for Directory Sync (user/group/directory changes delivered via webhooks or Events API) and an Audit Log events API for ingesting/exporting notable actions, but there's no direct evidence of webhooks/event streams specifically for core AuthKit auth events like sign-up or sign-in. Missing for 10: explicit webhook/event-stream support for sign-up and sign-in events (not just directory sync/audit log events), and independent confirmation of real-time auth event delivery.
